SUBARU_CALAMITY_EPOCH.title: Great Calamity
SUBARU_CALAMITY_EPOCH.description: The witch has finally fulfilled the purpose she was created for
SUBARU_CALAMITY_EPOCH.unlockInfo: {IsRevealed:Already|}win a run as [gold]Subaru Natsuki[/gold]{IsRevealed:| to reveal this epoch}.
SUBARU_CALAMITY_EPOCH.unlock: The witch has at last fulfilled the purpose for which she was created, and rises in her transfigured form to make her final challenge. The trump cards she plays one after another drive the countdown of destruction onward, and when the hands of that clock reach zero, the fireworks of mercy and compassion blanket the entire Empire. As this long war ends and the dawn glow has yet to fade, the hearts of the sword wolves are now as one, so that they may reach the sky beyond that dawn together with as many as possible.
